categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily engages in the research, development, production and sales of high-end spring products. Main product categories include: (1) Suspension system springs and stabilizer bars; (2) Body and interior decoration springs; (3) Powertrain system springs (valve springs); (4) General-purpose springs; (5) Elastic devices and stamped parts; (6) Precision injection molded parts. Products are mainly applied to the automotive industry, with secondary applications in engineering machinery, aerospace, electrical power, military, nuclear power, and valve sectors.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company has accumulated core technologies including: (1) Cold/hot forming technology for stabilizer bars (solid, hollow types) and suspension springs; (2) Advanced heat treatment and shot peening strengthening processes; (3) Mold design and development capabilities; (4) Material innovation including proprietary ML1900 high-strength, high-toughness spring steel; (5) Precision testing and quality control methods. The company operates multiple automated production lines and has introduced advanced equipment from Germany and Italy for wire drawing and heat treatment.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers include major domestic and international automotive OEMs: Geely, BYD, BMW Brilliance, Li Auto, Nio, Leapmotor, SAIC-GM, Changan, Changan Ford, JAC, Great Wall, Shaanxi Heavy Truck, Hyundai, and Jaguar Land Rover. Secondary customers include global Tier-1 suppliers: Wanxiang, ZF, Faurecia, Linamar, Tenneco, Magna, and Benteler. The company also serves non-automotive sectors including engineering machinery, aerospace, and power generation.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates six manufacturing bases across three major Chinese automotive clusters: (1) Long Triangle region: Xinchang (Zhejiang), Haining (Zhejiang), Shanghai; (2) Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei region: Beijing; (3) Northeast region: Changchun (Jilin). International presence includes sales to overseas markets with 2023 foreign sales representing 8.37% of total revenue. The company is establishing operations in Singapore, USA (Texas), and Mexico.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the midstream to downstream segments of the automotive supply chain. It functions as a Tier-1 supplier to major OEMs and Tier-1 component suppliers, providing finished spring products and elastic assemblies that are integrated into vehicle suspension systems, powertrains, and interior components. The company does not engage in raw material extraction but sources steel materials from suppliers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include: (1) Advancing lightweight design through new materials and manufacturing processes; (2) Developing high-fatigue-life, high-strength products aligned with vehicle safety and performance requirements; (3) Synchronous R&D with OEMs for new vehicle platforms; (4) Expanding modular and system-level component offerings; (5) Pursuing international market penetration; (6) Enhancing automation and precision manufacturing capabilities. The company maintains a national-level postdoctoral research station and has invested 51.35 million yuan in R&D during 2023.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through direct sales of manufactured spring products and elastic assemblies to automotive OEMs and Tier-1 suppliers. Revenue is recognized when products are delivered and accepted by customers (for domestic sales) or when export documentation is completed (for international sales). The company operates on a made-to-order basis with monthly purchase orders from customers. Secondary revenue comes from precision injection molded parts and other automotive components.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading domestic spring manufacturer with significant competitive advantages. Major competitors include other Chinese spring manufacturers and international suppliers. The company's competitive strengths include: advanced manufacturing technology, comprehensive product portfolio, established relationships with major OEMs, multiple production bases enabling just-in-time supply, and continuous innovation. The company holds approximately 52.97% of revenue from suspension springs, its core product category, and has achieved market leadership in certain segments.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company has demonstrated strong growth trajectory: 2023 revenue of 1.376 billion yuan (26.56% YoY growth), net profit attributable to parent company of 40.70 million yuan (compared to -37.63 million yuan loss in 2022), representing a significant turnaround. Operating cash flow increased 39.25% to 102.41 million yuan. Total assets reached 2.112 billion yuan. The company has grown from approximately 400 million yuan in revenue at IPO (2017) to over 1.3 billion yuan currently, demonstrating sustained expansion and improved profitability.
